title: VC ADSR Envelope Generator (PIC)
summary: A cheap PIC-based clone of the CEM3312/SSM2056 voltage-controlled ADSR, plus notes on its firmware: A/D polling of the CVs, a DDS-style phase accumulator for the envelope stages, and lookup tables for the control response. Superseded by the EnvGen8 chip.
